contradicting_evidence: Positive current alt-bucket medians and majority BTC outperformance could precede broader participation if they persist.
The 30d and 90d BlockchainCenter samples show majority altcoin outperformance of BTC, although their source states remain between published thresholds.
The historical drawdown and negative weekly settled-flow context could develop into sustained contraction if recovery attempts fail.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: The evidence does not establish a seven-day net direction. Selective recovery, repeated retests and a broader reversal remain distinguishable possibilities, but choosing among them requires new observations. No cycle-transition timing or broad-altseason outcome is supported.
falsification_conditions: Several sessions establish rising BTC and ETH prices, sustained ETH/BTC strength, broader participation and improving settled flows together, creating an upward edge.
Several sessions establish failed recoveries, persistent ETH/BTC deterioration, weakening breadth and adverse settled flows together, creating a downward edge.
Observed capital deployment and participation beyond the current proxy coverage materially resolve the transmission uncertainty.
missing_evidence: A multi-session price and relative-strength sequence spanning the forecast horizon.
New settled ETF sessions and a BTC-dominance trend rather than one settled level.
Confirmed capital deployment and broader-universe participation.
supporting_evidence: Current breadth is constructive but modest and proxy-only; it does not establish persistent broad expansion.
Stablecoin supply is up approximately 0.85% over 30 days but down approximately 0.28% over seven days, with deployment unconfirmed.
The latest ETF session is split between positive BTC flows and negative ETH flows, rather than showing aligned demand.
The structural prior supplies historical drawdown and partial-recovery context, but explicitly does not establish a stable longer-cycle phase.
